name: TrussCraft
intro: Kabaha saqafka alwaarka ah ee laga sameeyo saqafka moodeelka: kabaha caadiga ah, kabaha hoos u dhacaya (ama kabo hoose oo qaadaya kabaha jack iyo geesaha), kabaha dooxada saqafka weyn, liistada qaybaha, gooyidda iyo xidhidhka, culeyska iyo isku-darka aad gelisid, iyo hubinta ugu horeysa ee qaybta. Caawiye naqshadeed, ma aha naqshad.
